why: Private park with no presence and no price anywhere (2026-11-22): Google Maps 'Rooster's RV Park', Campground, 419 Striker Drive, Clear Lake SD 57226 (44.7550226,-96.6719839) is unclaimed with no phone, website, photos or reviews; not on RV Life (Algolia park index, query 'rooster' and a 44.6-44.9 / -96.9 to -96.45 box: none), not in the Good Sam directory cache, not on Hipcamp's Clear Lake SD page, no hit on clearlakesd.com (site search 'rooster', 'striker'), and web searches for the name and street found nothing. Esri imagery shows a real-looking gravel RV lot (two rows of ~16 angled pull-through pads, a few RVs) ~200 m NNE of the Google pin, so it exists, but it fails the private presence and price tests (cf. 5842 Outback precedent).
name: Rooster's RV Park
flags: The park is physically there: Esri World_Imagery (read 2026-11-22, hw 200 m at 44.7568,-96.6700) shows a gravel lot of ~32-34 angled pull-through pads in two rows between Clear Lake's west-side creek and the lake shore, with 5-6 RVs on it; Google's pin (44.7550,-96.6720) sits ~220 m SSW at the access road's junction. About 1 km west of 5879 Ulven Park and ~1 km SE of 5877 City Park - not either of them.

Revisit if it claims its Google listing or posts a rate/booking page: it would then need the price gate (US$50), Google rating, and the long-stay tests (the lot could be wind-farm/work-crew or seasonal parking; nothing says either way). Waterfront was not audited because the lead is skipped; the lake edge is ~150-250 m east of the pads on imagery, so it would not be lakefront.
